title: Concept: Express version disclosed in a response
description: The default Express route error for an unknown path in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The default handler confirms the framework and the exact route the router tried, which lets an attacker distinguish a missing route from a blocked one.
applicability: Deployments that render the default Express route error for an unknown path into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The default handler confirms the framework and the exact route the router tried, which lets an attacker distinguish a missing route from a blocked one.
